entities.summary: Nabataean, a notable figure in the history of Jordan, associated with Nabataean Kingdom and Petra (60 BCE–106). Preceded by Nabataean Zenith and Roman Annexation and Rise of the Nabataeans. Their legacy influenced Trajan annexes the Nabataean Kingdom as the province of Arabia Petraea.
